adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, access is denied when `request.referer` is missing because `URI(request.referer || '').host` becomes `nil`, which will not equal `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, raising `Discourse::InvalidAccess` (hard error in the iframe). This behavior is explicitly codified by the added controller spec (`"raises an error with no referer"`), so it’s intentional rather than an accidental defect, but it is a real, diff-grounded compatibility/UX concern for referer-less clients.
